text:
sam_ops: inc: automated pages didn't go out for PROD svc-auth-01. Seeing 'suppressed' entries in alert-log. Anyone oncall? :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Alert suppressed: webhook signature verification failed (webhook_id=wh_0x7a). reason=signature_mismatch. paging_skipped=true

laura_sre: Who rotated signing keys or changed the webhook header? @deploy-bot deployed anything around 11:00 UTC?

deploy-bot: Deployed auth-key-rotator v2 at 2024-10-12T11:02:10Z (job id rot-458). Change: emit header X-Signature-V2 and retire X-Signature after 30s grace.

priya_oncall: I didn't receive a page. Looking at the paging console now.

priya_oncall: curl of the notifier endpoint shows 403 when I replay webhook payload:
```
$ curl -i -X POST 'https://notify.internal/hooks/ingest' \\n  -H 'X-Signature: sha1=abc123' \\n  -d '{"alert":"svc-auth-01","ts":1765440000}'
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"signature_mismatch","expected":"sha256","received":"sha1"}
```

sam_ops: Oh — rotator switched to HMAC-SHA256 and renamed header. Our paging adapter only checks X-Signature (sha1) and silently classifies signature_mismatch as suppressable.

laura_sre: That's the config bug — signature_mismatch auto-suppress exists to cut down noisy webhook spam. But with key rotation it suppressed all legit alerts.

sam_ops: Manually overriding suppressor now and re-queueing alerts for immediate paging. Priya, expect a manual page in ~30s. :phone:

priya_oncall: Got manual page. Acknowledging. Customer impact: brief 11:02–11:12 UTC window, ~120 users affected (auth failures). Rolling mitigation in progress.

laura_sre: Short-term: rollback rotator to v1 config, restore X-Signature for backwards compatibility. Long-term: paging adapter to accept X-Signature-V2 and don't auto-suppress on signature_mismatch during rotation windows.

sam_ops: Recording handoff: Priya oncall remains lead for remediation and customer comms. I'll open an incident ticket and kick off a postmortem. Root cause summary to be: rotator header rename + suppressor rule masked failures.

deploy-bot: Rolled back auth-key-rotator to v1 at 2024-10-12T11:07:30Z (rot-457). Validation: webhooks now accept X-Signature again.

laura_sre: Thanks. We'll add a gating check before any future header renames and a temporary alert (pager) if signature_mismatch increases >10/min during rotations.

sam_ops: Thanks everyone — filing follow-up actions. :white_check_mark:
